title: Grievance Redressal Committee | KPGU
content: sal System is a vital part of any administration. It falls under the purview of University Administration to ensure the provision of a secure and conducive environment for the students. In accordance with UGC guidelines, the Grievance Redressal Committee has been established within the university to address grievances raised by the students.
